text_block_list.text:
ââHAAAAAAAAHH!!! ââYAAAAAAAHHH!!! 
ââORYAAAAAAAHHH!!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: (Aah—)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: It's so bright—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Stay Gold is so strong! She's not falling 
behind Silence Suzuka at all...!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
She was solid even at long distances. As 
expected of a top-tier powerhouse...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"What was that just now...? During the 
race, SteGo-senpai, Suzuka, and the others 
were sparkling—"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...It seems you intend to reach even 
greater heights. ...I certainly won't let 
myself fall behind."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Haha.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: (Maybe that's just how it is in the end—)
――Stego-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Hey, Suzuka. Good work out there.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I knew it, today... I ran better and felt 
better than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Don't just thank me, though. Make sure to 
thank them too.
Suzuka-saaan!! Stego-saaan!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Can you feel it?! Our running is shaking 
the very earth beneath the audience's 
feet!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
And we're gonna pierce the heavens too, 
with our fortune soaring like an explosive 
dragon!! Right now, it feels like we can 
do anything!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Indeed~. I am surprised myself~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"It feels like... I could bring spring to 
wherever I go."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Haha, everyone's got such great looks on 
their faces!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...I believe that applies to you as well, 
Senpai.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Huh—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ......Ah, well. That's true, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Fukukitaru. Bright.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ――I'm glad you guys are my peers.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: I'm glad I got to run with you all today.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Senpai—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh!! Look at that big smile on 
Stego-san's face!! This might bring some 
serious good fortune...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I am the one who wishes to thank 
you, Lord Stego.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Then since we're both in the same boat, 
how about we wrap things up here?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone. Let's definitely run together 
again.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
In the same wind, we will surely meet 
again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, Stay Gold's Takarazuka Kinen came 
to an end—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ――At a later date.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...That last race made me realize it all 
over again.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
No matter how strong I become on my own, 
there is a limit to that value—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
It was precisely because her fellow 
comrade shone so brightly that her own 
strength and worth could finally be 
proven.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it would have ended up the same... 
both now, and in another world—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...Not that I mind it in the slightest, of 
course.
choice_data_list:
I think that just shows how strong your 
bond with everyone is.

I think that just shows the strength of 
the bond between you and everyone else.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that's great. All thanks to the 
strength of your bonds, huh?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...It feels like a treasure slipped right 
into my pocket before I even noticed.
choice_data_list:
I hope you keep finding treasures like 
that moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: You're right.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what will happen at the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Autumn's presence is still far off. Yet 
her heart, and her eyes, gaze far into the 
distance—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Waiting for its arrival. ...For the yet 
unseen "Tenno Sho (Autumn)".
